parameters.content:
## Store 3 · Conductor

The phase 3 templates each work on products that carry their tag (`documents`, `needs-images`, `enrich`, `describe`, `faq`, `find-reviews`, `find-videos`). The conductor adds those tags in order, so every product that goes live is enriched without you tagging anything.

1. **Find new products** enrols live products it hasn't seen yet (a draft is picked up when it goes live) (`enrol: "all"` on the first run enrols the whole catalogue instead).
2. Each product moves through `stages`. A stage is finished when its tags are gone from the product (each template removes its own tag once it has drafted) **and** nothing for that product is still waiting for a decision in Slack. Descriptions wait for approved attributes that way.
3. A product that sits in a stage longer than `max_stage_days` moves on anyway, and the log line says so.
4. One line in your log channel when anything moved.

build.py writes `stages` from system.json, with each tag read from its template's own settings, and leaves out templates that aren't in your plan.

nodes.name: Run from /store
nodes.notes: /store run conductor. Header auth: Store run key.

nodes.name: Conductor settings
nodes.notes: enrol: "new" starts from the first run; "all" also enrols every product already live. stages comes from build.py.

nodes.name: Get Shopify token
nodes.notes: Client credentials grant: a fresh Admin API token for this run. See SETUP.md.

parameters.query: select coalesce((select value from store_state where key = 'conductor_since'), '') as since, now() as now

nodes.name: Find new products

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const s = $('Conductor settings').first().json; const since = $json.since || (s.enrol === 'all' ? '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z' : new Date($json.now).toISOString()); return JSON.stringify({ query: `query New($q: String!) { products(first: 250, sortKey: UPDATED_AT, query: $q) { nodes { id title updatedAt } } }`, variables: { q: `${s.product_query} updated_at:>'${since}'` } }); })() }}

nodes.notes: Live products changed since the last run, oldest change first, 250 a run. A draft that goes live counts as a change, so it's found then. On the very first run with enrol "new" this finds nothing and just starts the clock.

nodes.name: Enrol them

parameters.query:
with n as (select * from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as x(product_id text, title text)),
ins as (insert into store_pipeline (product_id, title, stage, stage_name) select product_id, title, 0, 'new' from n on conflict (product_id) do nothing returning 1)
insert into store_state (key, value, "updatedAt") values ('conductor_since', $2, now())
on conflict (key) do update set value = excluded.value, "updatedAt" = now()
returning (select count(*) from ins)::int as enrolled

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { const p = $json.data?.products?.nodes || []; const since = $('Get the last run').first().json.since; const s = $('Conductor settings').first().json; const start = since || (s.enrol === 'all' ? '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z' : new Date($('Get the last run').first().json.now).toISOString()); return [ JSON.stringify(p.map(x => ({ product_id: x.id, title: x.title }))), p.length ? p[p.length - 1].updatedAt : start ]; })() }}

nodes.notes: Adds products it hasn't seen at stage 0 (one it has seen keeps its stage) and moves the clock to the newest change.

nodes.name: Get open products

parameters.query: select * from store_pipeline where not done order by stage_started_at limit $1

nodes.notes: Oldest first, so a long backlog still moves.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: `query Tags($ids: [ID!]!) { nodes(ids: $ids) { ... on Product { id status tags } } }`, variables: { ids: $('Get open products').all().map(i => i.json.product_id).filter(Boolean) } }) }}

nodes.name: Build the waiting check
nodes.notes: Anything for these products still waiting for a decision in Slack, across every template.

nodes.name: Decide each product
nodes.notes: A stage ends when its tags are gone and nothing is waiting in Slack, or after max_stage_days.

nodes.name: Add the tags

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: `mutation Next($id: ID!, $tags: [String!]!) { tagsAdd(id: $id, tags: $tags) { userErrors { field message } } }`, variables: { id: $json.product_id, tags: $json.add_tags } }) }}

nodes.notes: Writes to Shopify: the next stage's tags, which the phase 3 templates pick up on their next run.

parameters.query:
with d as (select * from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) as x(product_id text, stage int, stage_name text, add_tags text, done boolean, note text))
update store_pipeline p set stage = d.stage, stage_name = d.stage_name, tags_added = coalesce(nullif(d.add_tags, ''), p.tags_added), done = d.done, note = coalesce(d.note, p.note), stage_started_at = now(), "updatedAt" = now()
from d where p.product_id = d.product_id
returning p.product_id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ JSON.stringify($('Moved?').all().map(i => ({ product_id: i.json.product_id, stage: i.json.stage, stage_name: i.json.stage_name, add_tags: i.json.add_tags.join(', '), done: i.json.done, note: i.json.note }))) ] }}

parameters.text: ={{ (() => { const m = $('Moved?').all().map(i => i.json); const by = {}; for (const x of m) by[x.stage_name] = (by[x.stage_name] || 0) + 1; const notes = m.filter(x => x.note).map(x => `• ${x.title}: ${x.note}`).slice(0, 10); const enrolled = $('Enrol them').first().json.enrolled || 0; return `:arrows_counterclockwise: Conductor${$('Conductor settings').first().json.dry_run ? ' (dry run)' : ''}: ${enrolled ? enrolled + ' new live products enrolled. ' : ''}` + Object.entries(by).map(([k, v]) => `${v} → ${k}`).join(', ') + (notes.length ? '\n' + notes.join('\n') : ''); })() }}
